{{Top|leg}}
The '''Jensen''' family was a clan of [[Moisture farmer/Legends|moisture farmers]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. They were friends of [[Ariq Joanson]], however they did not support his proposal to make peace with the [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]] and [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Sand People]].
